title: Probably Stolen: Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim, v1.00-REV2 + Bonus OST
description:
You never really know who’s on the other side of the counter. Today’s customer could be a security fisher for evidence, a revolutionary seeking leverage, or a fallen elite testing your usefulness. Every sale is a gamble. Approve it, refuse it, report it, or look away; someone is always taking notes. Reputation buys access and protection, but it also paints a target on your back. On this station, every client is a potential profit and a potential trouble.

Start as a gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, farmer, or from absolute rock bottom. Every product line has its own profit curve and its own way of ruining you, weapons bring inspections, chemicals bring addiction, water brings liability, contraband brings raids. Some trades need heavy machinery and permits, others just a good hiding spot and a straight face. The better the margins, the worse the consequences when something goes wrong. You’re not choosing a theme for your shop, you’re choosing which kind of trouble you’re willing to monetize.

Every item you stock carries its own risks. Cigarette packs need visual inspection before resale. Water must be tested and filtered. Weapons require permits and modifications. Profitable chemicals rely on closely guarded recipes. Rare items need proper appraisal to avoid overpaying. You can cut the product’s quality, relabel counterfeit products as genuine, or fence discounted, stolen goods if you believe Security won’t reach you. But beware, there’s always the mob justice. Suppliers overstate value, customers push their luck, and contraband often comes with issues you only notice after the deal is done. Your margins depend on how well you assess what’s in front of you.  Misjudge the item or the person selling it, and you absorb the cost.

Keep the rent paid and you can start thinking bigger. Expand your operation, run multiple businesses, and unlock new merchandise and production opportunities. But rent keeps rising, and confiscated stock or a bad deal can leave you struggling to make the next payment. Every purchase needs to earn its keep

A sentient AI chip went rogue and took its hosts with it. Augs look like everyone else … until they don’t. Stay alert, pick up on the signs. Every faction agrees on the policy, and you have the gun to enforce it. But missing the signs, or misreading them, carries its own price

The player takes on the role of Sam Fisher, an operative for the National Security Agency's sub agency, the Third Echelon—a secret cell that is never recognized by the U.S. government. Fisher is sent to T'Bilisi, Georgia, to find missing CIA agents investigating communications blackouts. He infiltrates the Georgian government to unveil a threat that could have devastating consequences for the American people.

title: Fallout
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: September 30, 1997
- **Genre**: Role-playing - Turn-based - Sci-fi
- **Developer**: Interplay
- **Publisher**: Interplay / Bethesda Softworks LLC

## Overview
Set in the aftermath of a world-wide nuclear war, Fallout challenges you to survive in an unknown and dangerous world. You will take the role of a Vault-dweller, a person who has grown up in a secluded, underground survival Vault. Circumstances arise that force you to go Outside to a strange world 80 years after the end of modern civilization—a world of mutants, radiation, gangs and violence. Your immediate task is to find a replacement for the broken water purification controller chip to save your fellow Vault dwellers from dehydration.

## Features
- Skill-based system allowing you to fine-tune your character.
- Character growth through experience gained from combat, adventure seeds, and non-combat events.
- Tactical turn-based combat where players can take unlimited time for decisions.
- Variety of different types of attacks, weapons, and attack skills.

description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: April 8, 2008
- **Genre**: Action - Adventure - Historical
- **Developer**: Ubisoft Montreal
- **Publisher**: Ubisoft

## Overview
The game takes place in 1191 Jerusalem during the middle of the Third Crusade. While the player technically plays as Desmond Miles, the story focuses on Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad, a member of a mysterious order of assassins. As the growing influence of the Order of the Knights Templar threatens the Brotherhood, Altaïr is caught in a clash between two powerful organizations that triggers devastating events threatening the world.

## Features
- Well-constructed story that will pleasantly surprise you many times along the way.
- Impressive level of interaction with the environment – crowds react to what you do and act accordingly.
- Open world gameplay lets you decide how and when to achieve objectives, where to go, and gives you nearly complete freedom to get there.

## Overview
As the Cold War drew to a close, the world believed that peace would reign across the globe. It seemed that a new age had dawned, an age of lasting unity between nations, but this was not the case. Instead the fight for global supremacy had only been forced underground into the battlefield of covert ops and evil acts of terror. Into this arena sprung a new force. Masked behind the guises of subterfuge, plausible deniability and information management, the Institute for Geotactical Intelligence raised the sword against those who would subjugate the world. Though the malignancy of terrorism has broken our world on occasion, the global crucible has not yet boiled over into World War III. For that thank the one-man army David Jones and the forever-unsung heroes of IGI.

## Features
- A great first-person shooter with a touch of stealth
- Over 30 authentic weapons
- Create you own plan and find your own way through the challenging campaign

title: GTA Vice City
description:

**Release Date:** October 29, 2002

### Overview
GTA Vice City transports players to the vibrant, neon-lit streets of a fictional Miami during the 1980s. You play as Tommy Vercetti, a former mobster who, after being released from prison, seeks to establish himself in the criminal underworld. As he navigates the challenges of betrayal, power struggles, and the glitzy lifestyle of Vice City, players engage in a rich narrative filled with memorable characters and iconic missions.

- A diverse range of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, and boats.  
- Engaging storyline with numerous side missions and activities.  
- Iconic soundtrack featuring a wide variety of 80s music.  
- Customizable properties and businesses to expand your criminal empire.
